monday.move: Take the rules-file idea and build a first version for the sales team's outbound emails, with a cold-critic agent reviewing the output.
monday.who: Me, alone first. The sales lead only after it works.
monday.stop_condition: The cold critic's picks match my gut on two samples. Otherwise drop it.
monday.blocker: Nobody in sales asked for it, and I haven't decided who maintains the rules file.

misconception.why: The line that an agent's self-report is the same kind of output as the work it reports on was a new angle. I still think the plan and review steps are beginner stuff, and I skipped the look-back. I would not have caught the soft answers if the page hadn't told me.

one_line: the middle (anti-branding, rules file, cold critic) is good. around it are about fourteen copies of the same consultant paragraph, and it moves at beginner pace.
